DB_TYPE.description: Database engine: postgres for production, sqlite for local dev

PG_HOSTNAME.description: PostgreSQL server hostname for data persistence

PG_DATABASE.description: PostgreSQL database name for Keycloak data (default: keycloak)

PG_USERNAME.description: Username with access to Keycloak's database schema

PG_PASSWORD.description: Password for the PostgreSQL database user account

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Master realm initial admin username (default: admin)

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Master realm admin password for initial setup only

KC_PROXY.description: Proxy mode: edge, passthrough, or reencrypt (default: edge)

KC_HTTP_ENABLED.description: Enable HTTP listener (default: true; set false for HTTPS-only)

KEYCLOAK_HOSTNAME.description: Public hostname URL for Keycloak access and tokens

PORT.description: Port the service listens on inside the container
